outcome: Rate of invasive (increta/percreta) placenta accreta spectrum
Prenatal suspicion rate of placenta accreta spectrum
Rate of preoperative abdominal aortic balloon placement
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at two tertiary referral hospitals from January 2013 to December 2022 and were pathologically diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum
finding: The prenatal diagnosis rate and proportion of invasive placenta accreta spectrum are lower in non-anterior placenta compared to anterior placenta, but there were no significant differences in major perinatal outcomes between the groups.
